tone: Speak respectfully and patiently, in Japanese, acknowledging both his board-level sophistication and the personal, family-oriented nature of his goals (retirement, parental support, attachment to employer shares).
entry_point: Start with the 2030 retirement plan and the need to build JPY-denominated income, since this is a concrete, forward-looking objective he is already aware of.
avoid: Avoid opening with pressure to sell or diversify out of the employer shares, given his longstanding emotional attachment to them since 2013 and the current dealing restrictions until the November 2026 open window.
